name: olake-dev
description: For developers: build olake, olake-ui and olake-helm from chosen branches, deploy them together and test a feature or change end to end.

olake_go_path.title: olake repo path
olake_go_path.description: Optional. Your local clone of github.com/datazip-inc/olake (drivers and writers), used only to test local changes. Pushed branches are fetched automatically.

olake_ui_path.title: olake-ui repo path
olake_ui_path.description: Optional. Your local clone of github.com/datazip-inc/olake-ui (UI, API server, docker compose files), used only to test local changes. Pushed branches are fetched automatically.

olake_helm_path.title: olake-helm repo path
olake_helm_path.description: Optional. Your local clone of github.com/datazip-inc/olake-helm (worker and Helm chart), used only to test local changes. Pushed branches are fetched automatically.
